about: Speech for the dealers (tools/speech.ts): which renderer draws the mouth, which voice reads, which rest film a dealer speaks over and the exact text of every line. The renderer is Scoutgaming's lip-sync worker (services/moving-gpu-worker in Jakeminator123/scoutgaming, release 8b1386c2…, its production image since 2026-11-11 according to docs/operations/images.json there), run in Docker inside WSL on this machine's graphics card and without network; nothing here touches Scoutgaming's production. bankId is the name the bank is bound to: 'paow-v2' because Scoutgaming already has an older dealer and film bank called PAOW, and calls a dealer from this repo Dealer V2.0 (as 'pamela-v2'). chat holds the chat's fixed replies: the dummy's own four answers (chat1 to chat4, the words of REPLIES in src/game-chat.ts), the line of the phase DEALER, and a reply each for a greeting, her name, how she is, the rules, thanks, luck, a loss, a win, a goodbye and a question she cannot answer (which reply answers what is decided by chatKey in src/speech-lines.ts). The lines are the ten a table needs (the SpeakLine ids of game/presentation.ts) with Scoutgaming's own texts, word for word (packages/presentation/contracts/recorded-line-texts.mjs and speech-lines.mjs, read 2026-11-13). names are the short Swedish names the studio's view Prov shows for the lines. A voice is found only by the account it lives in: key names the line in .env.local that holds that account's key (never the key itself), and a voice without one is read with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; languages gives the model and settings for another language than the voice's own. Paow's voice (Jakob 2026-11-13) is the one Scoutgaming's own Paow has, an instant clone in Kevin's ElevenLabs account, read in Swedish with eleven_multilingual_v2, which Jakob chose by ear over eleven_v3 (the proof paow-rost), and in English with Scoutgaming's setting for her (docs/media/PAOW-BANK-KORNING.md there). The other id Jakob gave, ZJEktbBRUOiQlTc5zJBT (a professional clone of the same name in the same account), cannot read: ElevenLabs answers voice_not_fine_tuned (tried 2026-11-13 with both models), so its training is not finished. 'jessica' is one of ElevenLabs' premade voices, with the settings Scoutgaming's bakes use (runpod_bake.py, PROVEN_VOICE_SETTINGS): the first films were made with it, and it needs no other account than the repo's own. Films made from this are takes of the step IDLE>IDLE with sound; they lie in assets/speech/<dealer>/ until they are entered in the bank.

sv.namn: Jag heter Paow, och jag är din dealer i kväll.
sv.hurmardu: Jag mår fint, tack. Korten verkar vara på gott humör i kväll.
sv.regler: Närmast tjugoett vinner, men gå inte över.
sv.otur: Det vänder snart, det brukar det göra.
sv.grattis: Grattis! Det där var snyggt spelat.
sv.hejda: Tack för i kväll, välkommen tillbaka!
sv.vetej: Det kan jag tyvärr inte svara på, men korten ljuger aldrig.

sv.goodluck: Insatserna är stängda. Lycka till vid mitt bord!
sv.insurance: Försäkringen är öppen. Vill du försäkra din hand?
sv.double: Du dubblar. Ett kort, nu gör vi det bästa av det.
sv.dealerblackjack: Dealern har blackjack. Den här rundan går till huset.
sv.dealerbust: Dealern är över tjugoett! Grattis, bordet vinner.
sv.win: Bra spelat! Njut av din vinst.
sv.push: Det är lika. Din insats betalas tillbaka.
sv.lose: Dealern vinner den här gången. Bättre lycka nästa runda.

en.goodluck: Bets are closed. Good luck at my table!
en.insurance: Insurance is open. Would you like to protect your hand?
en.double: Doubling down. One card, let's make it count.
en.blackjack: Blackjack! That is beautifully done. Congratulations!
en.dealerblackjack: Dealer has blackjack. This round goes to the house.
en.dealerbust: Dealer busts! Congratulations, the table wins.
en.push: It's a push. Your stake is returned.
en.lose: Dealer wins this one. Better luck next round.
